## History

Allan arrived in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) as the new minister alongside his wife, with the young, pleasant-faced couple visiting [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) while still on their honeymoon. During tea, he managed to have a pleasant conversation with [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md). He and his wife admired the decorated table before a mix-up with anodyne liniment ruined Anne's cake, leading his wife to gently comfort the devastated girl.

## Relationships

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/allan--anne-shirley.md)

Mrs. Allan serves as a supportive acquaintance and mentor to [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), offering warmth and encouragement. Their relationship begins on a memorable note when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally flavors a layer cake with anodyne liniment during a visit from the new minister and his wife; rather than taking offense, Mrs. Allan kindly comforts a devastated [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) in her room. Mrs. Allan continues to foster a close connection by inviting [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to tea at the manse, earning Anne's immense admiration and affection.

- Friend of — supportive acquaintance who approves of Anne's choices  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXI. A New Departure in Flavorings P53](../source/v01-c21.md#nw-v01-c21-p0053), [v1 CHAPTER XXIX. An Epoch in Anne’s Life P24](../source/v01-c29.md#nw-v01-c29-p0024), [v1 CHAPTER XXXVIII. The Bend in the Road P29](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0029)</sub>
